purpose: Give the reasoning backend bounded original-audio context for native-selected requests, instead of relying solely on potentially incomplete native descriptions.
runtime: Context mode explicitly selected; default description-only and arithmetic paths unchanged.
Original PCM snapshot frozen when native delegate opens; later user frames cannot enter it.
ASR hypothesis/receipt validated against original PCM; no expected answers or scoring fields.
Same GPU inference lock serializes ASR with native steps. Provider waits run asynchronously outside that lock.
No host keyword mute, forced delegation, canned speech, change to native listen/speak policy, automatic request retry or fallback transcript.
Provider keys remain on the Mac loopback proxy; no credentials on the GPU.
